ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram.caption:
If you’ve ever opened a GitHub repo and had no idea where to start, try this:

𝟭. Open any repo on GitHub.
𝟮. In the URL, replace “github” with “gitdiagram” and hit enter.
You get an interactive diagram of the whole project, showing how every file and section connects. You can also export the diagra
